checks.detail: Every packaged JSON, JSON Schema, and JSON-LD file parses as JSON.
All four JSON Schemas declare https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema and parse successfully.
All 93 source references collected from the delta and extracted view model resolve against 36 unique source-registry IDs; no duplicate IDs or obsolete SRC-HIPAA-308/SRC-HIPAA-312 aliases remain.
After excluding its companion $schema pointer, the packaged view-model JSON is byte-equivalent after JSON normalization to the a3-model object embedded in index.html.
The 36 packaged source records are byte-equivalent after JSON normalization to the sources array embedded in index.html.
Each of DR-01, DR-02, and DR-03 contains four bounded percentages summing to 100.
The executable inline JavaScript blocks in index.html and embed.html compile without syntax errors.
index.html is a complete HTML document; embed.html is intentionally a host fragment.
No external script, stylesheet, @import, unpkg, jsDelivr, or cdnjs runtime dependency is present. External hyperlinks in index.html are evidence citations only.

Ajv CLI 5 evaluated all four package instances against their Draft 2020-12 schemas with strict mode disabled for declared URI and date formats; those formats were checked separately with native URL parsing and ISO-date validation.

Headless Chrome exercised all five lenses and F0–F3 at 1440, 736, 390, and 320 CSS pixels after the public-name and boundary-language revision, with no console errors, page errors, remote runtime requests, or horizontal overflow.
